scripts.dev: npm run build -w @text-to-learn/contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web "npm run dev -w @text-to-learn/contracts" "npm run dev -w @text-to-learn/server" "npm run dev -w @text-to-learn/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @text-to-learn/contracts && npm run build -w @text-to-learn/server && npm run build -w @text-to-learn/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @text-to-learn/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check:providers: npm run build -w @text-to-learn/contracts && npm run check:providers -w @text-to-learn/server
scripts.evaluate:fixtures: npm run build -w @text-to-learn/contracts && node --import tsx tests/evaluate-fixtures.ts
scripts.evaluate:live: npm run build -w @text-to-learn/contracts && npm run evaluate:live -w @text-to-learn/server
scripts.evaluate:enhancements: npm run build -w @text-to-learn/contracts && node --import tsx tests/evaluate-enhancements.ts
